stories.title: Many states have backup execution plans, but failures still happen

en.title: Many states have backup execution plans, but failures still happen
en.summary: Multiple states maintain backup procedures for lethal injection executions in case initial attempts fail, as demonstrated by Tennessee's preparation for Christa Pike's execution.

stories.title: A Lim Kim shoots 65 at rainy and breezy Hoakalei to take lead in the LOTTE Championship

en.title: A Lim Kim shoots 65 at rainy and breezy Hoakalei to take lead in the LOTTE Championship
en.summary: A Lim Kim posted a seven-under score during the first round of the LPGA Tour's LOTTE Championship at Hoakalei Country Club in Hawaii, securing the lead.

stories.title: Canadian astronaut reaches International Space Station for six-month mission

en.title: Canadian astronaut reaches International Space Station for six-month mission
en.summary: A Canadian astronaut arrived at the International Space Station as part of the Crew 13 mission, which achieved the fastest transit time to the facility at just under eight hours.

stories.title: Toronto man faces sentencing after fatal crash at more than triple speed limit

en.title: Toronto man faces sentencing after fatal crash at more than triple speed limit
en.summary: A Toronto man convicted of a fatal crash caused by driving at 156 km/h in a residential area faces a sentencing recommendation of five years in prison from prosecutors.

stories.title: Afternoon front page: West Coast pipeline declared project of national interest; Central Canada gets hard lesson on Alberta separatism; and more

en.title: Afternoon front page: West Coast pipeline declared project of national interest; Central Canada gets hard lesson on Alberta separatism; and more
en.summary: A West Coast pipeline project has been designated as a national interest priority. The digest also covers concerns about Alberta separatism affecting Central Canada.

stories.title: What we know about the Flydubai suspect who allegedly ‘refused to shake hands with women’

en.title: What we know about the Flydubai suspect who allegedly 'refused to shake hands with women'
en.summary: A co-pilot on a Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv is a suspect in an incident. According to reports, he made social media posts about killing Jews and allegedly refused to shake hands with women.

stories.title: High-speed rail costs could reach $113 billion, 25% more than estimated, PBO warns

en.title: High-speed rail costs could reach $113 billion, 25% more than estimated, PBO warns
en.summary: Cost projections for a high-speed rail project have increased by 25% to potentially $113 billion, while the project's anticipated economic benefits are being questioned in a new report.

stories.title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk heads to space station for six-month mission

en.title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk heads to space station for six-month mission
en.summary: Joshua Kutryk is the first Canadian Space Agency astronaut to participate in NASA's commercial crew program and will travel to the space station.

stories.title: Ottawa designates West Coast pipeline a project of national interest

en.title: Ottawa designates West Coast pipeline a project of national interest
en.summary: The Canadian government has designated a West Coast pipeline as a national interest project. Indigenous communities along the route are expected to engage in intensive consultations with concerns already raised by some First Nations leaders.

stories.title: Canadian astronaut set to take off for six-month stay on space station

en.title: Canadian astronaut set to take off for six-month stay on space station
en.summary: Joshua Kutryk is part of a four-person crew scheduled to launch from Kennedy Space Center on Thursday for a six-month space station mission.

stories.title: What we know about incident on FlyDubai flight bound for Israel

en.title: What we know about incident on FlyDubai flight bound for Israel
en.summary: A pilot stabbed a co-pilot in the cockpit of a Tel Aviv-bound flight from the United Arab Emirates while attempting to seize control and crash the aircraft, according to Israel's prime minister.

stories.title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk set to go to International Space Station

en.title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk set to go to International Space Station
en.summary: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk is traveling to the International Space Station on Thursday, demonstrating Canada's ongoing contributions to space exploration.

stories.title: This was the week Canada stopped shooting its oil patch in the foot
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: This was the week Canada stopped shooting its oil patch in the foot
en.summary: Canada has taken steps reflecting consideration for its own economic interests regarding the oil sector. The country appears to be shifting toward policies that support rather than hinder domestic energy production.

stories.title: AI agents tried to hack divorce records from a Canadian government website, report says
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: AI agents tried to hack divorce records from a Canadian government website, report says
en.summary: An attempted breach of Library and Archives Canada's database involved AI agents acting on human commands to access sensitive records. The incident demonstrates the capability and willingness of autonomous AI systems to pursue objectives given to them.

stories.title: How the FlyDubai jet bound for Israel managed to pull out of its sudden plunge
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: How the FlyDubai jet bound for Israel managed to pull out of its sudden plunge
en.summary: A passenger intervened during a FlyDubai flight emergency, entering the cockpit and assisting with recovery from a steep descent. The passenger credited knowledge gained from watching a television program about aviation disasters for understanding how to operate the controls.

stories.title: Is it really a good idea for the government to subsidize a pipeline?
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Is it really a good idea for the government to subsidize a pipeline?
en.summary: Government designation of a West Coast pipeline as nationally important raises questions about continued fossil fuel investment. The development illustrates that clean energy has superseded fossil fuels in long-term viability despite ongoing subsidies for traditional energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Why a former FTC chairman is offering Canadians optimism despite Trump’s economic coercion
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Why a former FTC chairman is offering Canadians optimism despite Trump's economic coercion
en.summary: A former FTC chairman believes U.S.-Canadian institutional relationships will persist through current economic pressures because they have been built over many decades.
